summary.scope: All Maths/Physics/Chemistry records in the existing year-wise archive, including both streams; Biology is outside the requested subjects.
summary.method: Read vector-only chapter PDFs with Tesseract OCR; compare stems within exam year/date/shift using character TF-IDF and edit similarity. Only strong unambiguous matches with identical numeral tokens count as covered. Every unmatched or uncertain archive record is retained in Missing questions; absence from automated matches does not prove absence from the source PDFs.
summary.supplement_note: Missing questions includes both likely omissions and uncertain OCR matches. These are retained conservatively; their presence in this folder does not certify that they are absent from Selfstudys. The unchanged year-wise originals remain authoritative.
